name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. The '08' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30), not an address residue (function address is 0x33219, unrelated to 08). Verified dispatched from the chapter init handler table at 0x51d8d, whose slot holds 0x00033219 (little-endian 19 32 03 00). Name accurately reflects the chapter-8 prologue init purpose.
purpose: Chapter 8 (王城前的戰鬥) init handler: a flat chapter-prologue orchestrator dispatched from the chapter init handler table; plays the chapter-8 opening scene then hands control to the player.
logic_summary: Re-inits battle state, then pan camera (7,0x20) -> cutscene 0x1F -> dialog page 0; pan camera (7,0x17) -> cutscene 0x20 -> dialog page 1; clear all char facings; pan camera to char 0. No char init, no portrait load, no global-state writes, and never resets data_fd2_battle_anim_phase. Leading __CHK(0x28) is the Watcom frame-size probe. In the binary it tail-JMPs (0x33278 -> 0x33028) into chapter_04's trailing dialog-arg-push alt-entry, which JMPs (0x33044 -> 0x3312D) into the shared epilogue owned by chapter_05; the src is the functionally-equivalent (Layer 2) straight-line reconstruction.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs the chapter-8 prologue side effects then returns to the dispatcher.

comment_original_issue: Content was accurate and well-written; only ASCII violation was 3 em-dashes (U+2014) at the 'global-state writes at all', 'two dialog pages)', and 'Post-action: (default' lines, which the code-comment ASCII rule requires be '--'. Chinese chapter title 「王城前的戰鬥」 is a proper noun and was kept.
notes: Decompilation matches src body exactly (init_battle_state; pan(7,0x20); cutscene 0x1F; dialog page 0; pan(7,0x17); cutscene 0x20; dialog page 1; clear_facing; pan_to_char(0)). Disassembly confirms PUSH 0x28 / CALL __CHK at entry and JMP 0x00033028 tail at 0x33278, matching the comment's binary-layout description. Xref to this fn is data-only from 0x00051d8d (chapter init handler table slot = 0x00033219), confirming 'dispatched, 0 direct callers'.
